Strategy Detail: Pinzo should build the category around Google Business Profile operations, not only generic 'GMB tool' keywords.
Execution Rule: Create one product authority hub and multiple problem/feature/industry clusters.
Why It Matters: This captures both high-volume educational traffic and high-intent buyer traffic.

Strategy Detail: The uploaded universe is large, but most volume is navigational/head-term demand with high difficulty.
Execution Rule: Use head terms for homepage relevance; use long-tail pain queries for first traffic wins.
Why It Matters: This avoids wasting 6 months chasing keywords Google/large sites already own.

Strategy Detail: Build an interconnected GBP knowledge base: setup, verification, optimization, reviews, posts, photos, services, categories, suspension, reporting.
Execution Rule: Every page must link to 3–8 related pages and one conversion asset.
Why It Matters: Google needs to understand Pinzo as a specialist, not a random SaaS website.

Strategy Detail: Free tools should become the traffic-to-lead bridge: audit, description generator, category finder, review reply generator, post ideas.
Execution Rule: Launch tools as indexable pages with examples and FAQs.
Why It Matters: Utility pages earn links and convert better than plain articles.

Strategy Detail: Publish product, service, feature, agency, and industry pages before scaling blogs.
Execution Rule: SEO traffic without BOFU pages leaks conversion.
Why It Matters: A SaaS/managed service needs sales pages to convert organic demand.

Strategy Detail: Start with doctors/clinics because Pinzo already has healthcare traction, then expand to jewellery, restaurants, salons, coaching, retail chains.
Execution Rule: Each industry page should include specific categories, services, reviews, post ideas, and reporting examples.
Why It Matters: Industry pages turn generic GBP features into business pain/value.

Strategy Detail: Use pSEO only after core pages index and after a quality template is proven.
Execution Rule: Start with 25 pages max, evaluate indexation and impressions, then scale.
Why It Matters: Prevents thin-page risk while unlocking thousands of long-tail combinations.

Strategy Detail: Every SEO page needs a next step based on intent: audit, checklist, generator, consultation, report sample, or trial.
Execution Rule: Do not use the same CTA everywhere.
Why It Matters: Intent-matched CTAs improve lead rate and lead quality.

Strategy Detail: Pages must answer fully, include examples, templates, screenshots/tool outputs, and cite official Google guidance where relevant.
Execution Rule: Avoid generic AI copy and keyword stuffing.
Why It Matters: Google’s people-first content guidance rewards useful, original content.

Strategy Detail: Segment Search Console by /guides/, /features/, /industries/, /tools/ and track assisted conversions.
Execution Rule: Review weekly in first 90 days, then monthly.
Why It Matters: Traffic only matters if it creates demos, trials, or managed-service leads.
